verses.verse:
तीव्र मध्यम गान्धार मध्ये स्याच्छुद्ध मध्यमः।
ऋषभ षड्ज मध्ये तु कोमलो ऋषभोमतः।।३०।।
verses.text: Between tīvra Madhyama and Gāndhāra is śuddha Madhyama; between Ṛṣabha and Ṣaḍja komal Ṛṣabha is held [to lie].

commentary.text: Between tīvra (sharp) Madhyama and Gāndhāra, śuddha Madhyama; and between Ṛṣabha and Ṣaḍja, komal Ṛṣabha: this is the proper placing.
